cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right, I'll get this cupboard standing straight. Pass me the instructions and we'll sort it out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can read them. I only need someone to hold the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You read; I'll manage the holding. Tell me where you want my hands.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here, while I put the hinge in. Don't move until I say.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll keep it steady under your direction. That means you do need me for this bit, doesn't it?
